query: SELECT 'genres' AS "field!", g.id AS "id!", g.name AS "name!", j.source_version_id FROM manifestation_genres j JOIN genres g ON g.id = j.genre_id WHERE j.manifestation_id = $1 UNION ALL SELECT 'moods', g.id, g.name, j.source_version_id FROM manifestation_moods j JOIN moods g ON g.id = j.mood_id WHERE j.manifestation_id = $1 UNION ALL SELECT 'tags', g.id, g.name, j.source_version_id FROM manifestation_tags j JOIN tags g ON g.id = j.tag_id WHERE j.manifestation_id = $1 ORDER BY 1, 2
